snippet.title: Proxima - Teaser
snippet.description:
Proxima is a game I've been solo developing for a little bit now in my free time! I'm so excited to share it, and you can wishlist it now at: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4009990/Proxima/

In the shadow of Europa, a top secret research station run by mega-corporation Artemis falls to alien chaos. Scavenge, explore, and interact with a fully reactive and physics-driven world built around immersion as you meet other crew members, and fight, sneak, or puzzle-solve your way to survival – and uncover the truth.

Website:
https://www.calebsmores.com/proxima-game
